preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Establish correct rifle and viewmodel animation boundaries, then make replay-scoped event identity and performance state observable so Tester can qualify the complete combat-readability slice without process restarts while preserving clean boot, the intact soldier/M4 package, accepted map, HUD, input, and weapon framing.

diagnosis.root_cause: Two concrete integration defects prevent qualification. First, the M4 humanoid semantic table explicitly maps idle, aim, fire, and reload to pistol clips, while product recoil control crosses the registered viewmodel boundary through component-private behavior; repeated evidence-only passes cannot repair either binding. Second, replay resets producer sequences without one authoritative run epoch shared by event producers and presentation caches, and the candidate exposes no bounded mission-phase performance qualification surface. This permits cross-run shot identity collisions and leaves complete-mission frame-time and lifecycle stability unprovable.

stop_conditions: Stop and report an asset-binding blocker if the intact humanoid libraries contain no rifle-compatible core clips; do not retain pistol substitutions, edit imported meshes, or detach the M4 from its authored package.
Stop component work if the registered source receipt cannot establish an intact AK-74 viewmodel baseline; do not reconstruct or patch component internals as a substitute.

Keep the performance gap open if complete-mission raw frame-time samples or three uninterrupted lifecycle cycles cannot be retained; do not infer performance from source inspection or isolated screenshots.
Stop runtime mutation after any stateful MCP outcome becomes unknown, request the host-owned workspace rebind, and preserve the last known candidate state.
Reject the iteration if clean boot, ordinary movement/mouse look, R-only reload, F6 reset, or accepted Hip/ADS framing regresses.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy: replace label-based pistol substitution with fail-closed rifle semantic resolution, restore the registered viewmodel directly and keep product behavior outside it, then introduce one lifecycle run epoch plus bounded performance/counter instrumentation. This advances concrete implementation instead of repeating transform tuning or an evidence-only matrix pass.

code: Run Godot import/parse and clean-boot checks with no missing resources, script errors, signal duplication, or changes to the intact map and accepted component hierarchy.
Compare the materialized AK-74 component against its registered receipt/source and require no unexplained internal drift or product calls to private component methods.
Inspect every required rifle semantic mapping against the instantiated AnimationPlayer and require fail-closed startup diagnostics for unresolved clips.
Inspect the run-epoch and qualification schemas for monotonic identity, bounded storage, presentation-only ownership, effect caps, and explicit lifecycle reset coverage.
